purpose_zh: 把 AI 创新带全部场景的运行治理形式化为可执行状态机：绿灯通行、黄灯限速（人工抽查）、红灯暂停（人工接管、可退役）；状态迁移须人工签认；退役为终态。
purpose_en: Formalizes the operating governance of all belt scenarios as an executable state machine: green to run, yellow to slow (manual sampling), red to pause (manual takeover, decommissionable); transitions require human sign-off; decommission is terminal.
governance_principles_zh: 服务等价：不使用 AI 者获得等价人工服务
弱势保护：老幼病障不作为首轮测试对象
红牌复核权：受影响群体代表可发起红牌暂停
数据最小化：场景不依赖非公开数据与个人隐私
人工终审：法定程序与公共决策由人完成
governance_principles_en: Service equivalence: non-AI users receive equivalent human service
Vulnerable protection: elderly, children, disabled are not first-round test subjects
Red-card review right: affected-group representatives may initiate red-light pause
Data minimization: scenarios do not rely on non-public data or personal privacy
Human final review: statutory procedures and public decisions remain human

transitions.condition_zh: 试点期通过：达到最小成功阈值且通过人工复核
transitions.condition_en: Pilot passed: minimum success threshold met and human review passed

transitions.condition_zh: 出现黄灯事项：异常指标、投诉或抽检不合格
transitions.condition_en: Yellow event: abnormal metrics, complaints, or sampling failure

transitions.condition_zh: 红灯事项：安全事故、隐私侵害或受影响群体代表发起红牌
transitions.condition_en: Red event: safety incident, privacy violation, or red-card initiated by affected-group representatives

transitions.condition_zh: 红灯事项：同上，可直接跳转
transitions.condition_en: Red event: same as above, direct transition allowed

transitions.condition_zh: 整改复核通过：红不得直转绿，须复核签认后转黄观察一期
transitions.condition_en: Remediation review passed: red cannot go directly to green; must transition to yellow for one observation period after sign-off

transitions.condition_zh: 退役：评估后永久下线，记录公开留存
transitions.condition_en: Retired: permanently decommissioned after evaluation; records remain public

transitions.condition_zh: 任何状态可经人工评估直接退役
transitions.condition_en: Any state may be retired directly after human evaluation

red_light_drill.frequency_zh: 首开行动含一次完整演练，此后每季度一次
red_light_drill.frequency_en: First-phase actions include one full drill; quarterly thereafter
runbook_zh: 发布演练预告与公众通知
任选一个运行中场景触发红牌
执行人工接管与数据冻结
公开失败记录与复盘报告
恢复或退役决策由人工签认
runbook_en: Publish drill notice and public notification
Trigger a red card on one running scenario
Execute manual takeover and data freeze
Publish failure records and review report
Recovery or retirement decision signed off by humans

scenarios.manual_fallback_zh: 人工策展与静态艺术装置
公开数据板与人工解说

scenarios.name_zh: 扳道房·人工接管测试场
scenarios.manual_fallback_zh: 红牌演练为核心，常规人工测试
线下合规咨询与人工审计
人工数据流程与线下验证
实体荣誉墙与人工评选

status_note_zh: 全部场景当前状态为概念建议中的黄灯待试点，未授权运行；本协议为概念治理机制，供专业团队与运营主体深化，不构成合规认定或法定程序。
status_note_en: All scenarios are conceptual yellow-light pending pilots, not authorized to run; this protocol is a conceptual governance mechanism for professional teams and operators, not a compliance determination or statutory procedure.
